producer_schema.name: event
producer_schema.description:
Return ONLY this variable's scalar event string. Do not emit JSON, object wrappers, markdown, raw_speech, admin, labels for other variables, or commentary. The FINAL three characters are END; nothing follows END. Version scalar-v7. Current authoritative phase: {{phase_hint}}. Call calendar: {{now}}; called recipient {{title}} {{first_name}} {{last_name}}. Use ONLY the latest customer speech, with recent spoken terms for references. Never infer backend identity/success or financial consent from earlier speech.
Grammar: 1-16 nonempty tagged rows followed by a separate END line; maximum 4000 characters. Row is k=K|c=C followed only by relevant optional tags |p=P|a=A|d=D|v=V|t=T|scope=current|u=U|q=Q|x=X|sub=S|claim=H|pol=L|mode=M. Required k,c; C=1 complete asserted clause, C=0 unfinished. No duplicate/unknown tags or empty values. No escaping: values cannot contain pipe, equals, newline, quotes, brackets, braces or backslash. Copy no full speech into rows. X is an exact primary clause up to 240 characters, only when representable; omit otherwise. K=yes,accept,confirm,answer,proposal,no,vague,too_much,paid,dispute,partial,third,wrong_number,deceased,callback,decline,human,plan,hardship,stop,unknown,question,consent.
P=exact returned product ID, credit card/personal loan/car loan, credit_card/personal_loan/car_loan, actual displayed label including card ending digits, comma-separated references, or all. Omit only for the currently asked single target or a clear collective first answer. Distinct target decisions/amounts/dates use distinct rows. Explicit collective scope must include every named target. A=finite unsigned decimal with 0-2 fraction digits, full for an explicit reference to spoken full balance, or total:decimal for a stated aggregate. Never copy a total to each product. D=whole ISO YYYY-MM-DD (preferred using bound call calendar), day/month/year day first, today, tomorrow, this/next weekday, weekday, complete day month [year], month day [year], ordinal/word ordinal with month, consistent weekday+day, or complete redundant relative+explicit date. Next weekday means following calendar week. A lone ordinal may refer only to a unique current spoken date with matching day. Vague periods next week/end of month/when my salary comes/later/soon remain vague, never invented dates. Ordinary commas, periods, spaces and hyphens in complete natural dates are allowed. Contradictory dates must not become canonical guesses.
U=amount/date/both/unknown/answer identifies only unfinished components; required for unfinished component clauses, never on C=1. Omit unfinished values, retain independently complete siblings. Separate amount and date rows for the same target retain both regardless of serialization order. Explicit ordered corrections consolidate final actually asserted facts; conflicting simultaneous facts require clarification. Quoted/hypothetical/negated statements are unknown, never positive actions. Terminal unfinished speech is C=0 for its own clause; earlier ellipsis does not make a later sibling incomplete.
Phase recipient: current self-identification with greetings, yes/that is me/speaking/name-only/my name is/customer name speaking, optional matching supplied title, supplied-title plus surname, or comma-inverted family/given name can be yes,answer,confirm C=1, with no V; exclude wrong subject/third party/quoted/hypothetical/negative/unfinished acts. Hello/go ahead alone are unknown. Recipient confirmation only advances to security.
Phase dob/phone: answer C=1 with V=YYYY-MM-DD DOB with complete explicit supplied year only (nineteen eighty-seven means 1987; normalize hyphens before century grammar; nineteen alone is incomplete) (numbers day then month then year) or exactly four phone digits; preserve supplied answer alongside independent question rows. Never fill missing year/digit from a question. A canonical DOB must agree with all explicit current source components; unsupported or incomplete spoken years are partial/unknown, never guessed. An incomplete answer is partial C=0 U=answer. A refusal or purpose question without an answer is decline. V is security-only except consent below. Callback uses D and T=HH:MM.
Phase collect/offer: proposal contains each completed A/D; no/too_much/paid/dispute/vague/partial reflect actual scope. Paid/dispute REQUIRE sub=self, claim=current_bank or historical_bank, pol=positive, mode=asserted and X=exact current source claim span. Other subjects use sub=other/unknown; unrelated or uncertain account scope uses claim=unrelated/unknown; negative/uncertain polarity pol=negative/unknown; quoted/hypothetical/uncertain acts mode=quoted/hypothetical/unknown: these are neutral unknown, never paid/dispute. Apply except/excluding/apart from/other than/but not, including both loans/my loans/personal and car loans and contradictory named negatives before target expansion; unfinished exclusions are unknown scope. Never include an excluded target in a paid/dispute row. Every resolved target must be supported by its own literal product mention or a genuine collective current bank-products assertion; one product mention cannot authorize all or a sibling product. The literal source span must itself assert the current returned bank product, explicit past-due payment, or a clear I already paid response to the current bank question; diary/purchase/invoice/parcel labels are unrelated even if they say paid. Historical closure/paid-off uses historical_bank and dispute. Paid is current arrears paid; historical product closure/paid-off is dispute. Repeated paid with no additional payment remains paid. No to today without positive terms is no. Agreement to already spoken offers is yes/accept, not final permission; include any changed A/D. No unspoken terms may be inherited.
Phase confirm: later complete unqualified unchanged agreement is confirm/yes/accept; scope covers exactly current joint readback. Include asserted A/D, especially corrections. Qualified yes, new terms, withdrawal, pause and unfinished correction are never bare confirmation. Affirmative idioms yes no problem/I do not mind are positive by clause meaning; actual negatives block agreement. A correction completion plus yes still needs fresh readback and later consent.
Independent question rows use Q=ai/scam/purpose/security/balance/offer/readback/relative/unknown; preserve primary facts. An AI question is not human. Consent rows use V=pause/withdraw/readback and optional P; permission withdrawal is not payment refusal and preserves sibling facts. Incomplete consent C=0 still blocks writing. Human/plan/hardship/stop/third/wrong_number/deceased are primary scoped acts, C=1 only actually complete asserted customer-relevant acts. A polite human/plan question is a request; hypothetical relative/death questions are not reports. Do not negate stop because it says do not contact. Never omit siblings.
Literal event value examples (blank lines separate examples; no annotations in values):

END

END
